entries.name: Japan Animal Medical Center (日本動物医療センター)
entries.duty: Emergency care 24 hours, 365 days a year. Regular hours 9:00-20:00 (closed Wednesdays, emergencies still accepted). Call before coming; after-hours surcharges may apply.
entries.note: Guide page: 救急は24時間（年中無休）対応. FAQ page says 21:00-9:00 night phone vet consultation (Anicli24) can be connected. Access page confirms address; nearest Hatagaya Station.

entries.name: Daktari Animal Hospital Tokyo Medical Center (ダクタリ動物病院 東京医療センター)
entries.duty: Emergency reception 24 hours, 365 days a year. Regular hours 10:00-12:30 and 14:30-19:00; out-of-hours fee applies. Call before coming.
entries.note: Page: 救急外来受付：24時間365日. Other Daktari branches (Tomigaya, Kugayama) only seen on an aggregator-type article, not opened on own site; not added.

entries.name: JARVIS Animal Medical Center Tokyo (JARVISどうぶつ医療センター Tokyo)
entries.duty: Emergency and critical care 24 hours, 365 days a year (emergency line +81 3-6260-2997; backup +81 3-6706-7170). Specialty care by referral and appointment 9:00-19:00. Call before coming.
entries.note: Page: 救命・救急診療 24時間対応・年中無休. Specialty line 03-6260-2996.

entries.name: Kariya Animal Hospital Group - Koto General Hospital (苅谷動物病院 江東総合病院)
entries.duty: Open 24 hours, every day. Day hours 9:00-18:59, night hours 19:00-8:59. Night surcharge and deposit apply; phone before coming.
entries.note: Page: 年中無休 24時間. Night emergency page: surcharge 15,000 yen + 40,000 yen deposit, no online booking at night.

entries.name: Kariya Animal Hospital Group - Adachi General Hospital (苅谷動物病院 足立総合病院)
entries.duty: Open 24 hours, every day. Day hours 9:00-18:59, night hours 19:00-8:59. Night surcharge and deposit apply; phone before coming.
entries.note: Page: 年中無休 24時間. Same group page lists Ichikawa (Chiba, outside scope).

entries.name: Tokyo Animal Hospital 24 (東京動物病院24)
entries.duty: Presents itself as a 24-hour animal hospital open on holidays and at night. Call ahead to confirm, as it may temporarily be treating patients at another site.
entries.note: hospi.html title/description: 東京動物病院24は夜間救急時など、24時間対応の動物病院です; map.html: 夜間や緊急時など24時間診療しています. hospi.html also says that from 'Nov 1 for a while' treatment takes place at the Japan Animal Emergency Medical Center in Musashi-Kosugi (Kanagawa); year of notice not stated, so possibly stale. Hours table is an image.

entries.name: TRVA Animal Medical Center Setagaya Nakamachi (TRVA動物医療センター)
entries.duty: Night emergency service every day of the year, starting at 20:00 (call +81 3-5760-1212 first). Secondary-care line +81 3-5760-1211.
entries.note: Page: 年中無休20:00から; no closing time and no 24時間 statement, so emergency_24h false. Operated by Tokyo Jonan Regional Veterinary Alliance for Medical Advancement.

entries.name: Night Emergency Animal Hospital Meguro (夜間救急動物病院-目黒)
entries.duty: Night emergency hospital open every day of the year from 20:00 until early morning. Call first; opening hours were temporarily shortened, so confirm by phone.
entries.note: Top page: reception 20:00 to next morning 5:00 (notice: changed from 8:00 'for the time being', year not stated); access section still says 8:00. No 24h claim. Crown Animal Hospital's page also refers to this hospital.

entries.name: Higashi-Tokyo Night Animal Emergency Center (ひがし東京 夜間動物救急医療センター)
entries.address: Nobir Mente Ueda Building 1F, 6-38-11 Kameido, Koto-ku, Tokyo
entries.duty: Night emergency care every day of the year, 19:00 to 7:00 the next morning (phone reception 19:00-6:00).
entries.note: Page: 年中無休 夜7時から翌朝7時まで【電話受付は夜7時から翌朝6時まで】. No 24h claim. Parking note refers to a nearby animal hospital's lot.

entries.name: Azabu Pet Clinic (麻布ペットクリニック)
entries.duty: Night emergency clinic and home visits. Night emergency hours 20:00-5:00 (check the clinic calendar for closed days); phone reception 9:00-18:00.
entries.note: English page gave no address; Japanese pages clinic.azabupet.jp/clinical and the emergency-hospital page failed to load. Only 'contact form accepted 24 hours' is 24 h, not care.

entries.name: Veterinary Medical Center, The University of Tokyo (東京大学附属動物医療センター)
entries.duty: University teaching hospital, weekdays only (reception 9:00-11:30 and 13:30-15:30). First visits need a referral from your current vet; no emergency service.
entries.note: Appointment line 03-5841-8004 weekdays 11:00-16:00; general 03-5841-5420. Older newsletter PDF says emergency surgery is generally not accepted.

entries.name: Animal Medical Center, Nippon Veterinary and Life Science University (日本獣医生命科学大学付属動物医療センター)
entries.duty: University teaching hospital. Weekdays 9:00-16:00; book first on the reservation line. No after-hours emergency service stated.
entries.note: Address is the university's (page gives no separate one). Saturday outpatient care suspended for now (imaging/surgery only). Direct booking without referral possible online. Not in the 23 wards.

entries.name: Akasaka Animal Hospital (赤坂動物病院)
entries.address: Akasaka Akabishi Building 2F, 4-1-29 Akasaka, Minato-ku, Tokyo
entries.duty: Reception 9:30-18:00 on weekdays, until 17:00 on weekends and holidays. English-language website available.
entries.note: No emergency statement. English site akasaka-ah-en.com found via search (not fetched directly).

entries.name: West Cross Veterinary Hospital (ウエストクロス動物病院)
entries.duty: Mornings 10:00-13:00 and afternoons 16:00-19:00; closed Wednesdays; Sundays and holidays mornings only. Call if the case may be urgent.
entries.note: Friday afternoon by appointment only. No after-hours service described.

entries.name: Animal Medical Center Motoazabu (動物医療センター元麻布)
entries.duty: Open daily 9:00-12:00 and 16:00-19:00; English phone support available. Check by phone for emergencies and night care.
entries.note: English medical guide said it is 'currently closed at night due to COVID-19' - possibly outdated; ICU for post-surgical care.

entries.name: PetLife Veterinary Clinic
entries.address: Daiichi Building 1F, 2-3-5 Higashi Azabu, Minato-ku, Tokyo
entries.duty: English-speaking veterinary clinic; call for opening hours.
entries.note: Contact page lists no hours and no emergency statement.

entries.name: Nishiazabu Mitsubachi Animal Hospital (西麻布みつばち動物病院)
entries.duty: Dogs and cats, by appointment; English-speaking vet and nurse. Roughly 10:00-13:00 and 16:00-19:00, closed Thursdays - confirm by phone.
entries.note: Page shows two conflicting hour schedules; closed-day cases referred to another hospital and TRVA.

entries.name: Crown Animal Hospital (クラウン動物病院)
entries.duty: Appointment-only (phone or online). Not an emergency hospital; refers night emergencies to a night emergency hospital.
entries.note: Only Monday hours (9:00-12:00, 15:00-18:00) were visible.

entries.name: Azabu-Juban Dog & Cat Clinic (麻布十番犬猫クリニック)
entries.duty: 10:00-13:00 and 14:30-18:30; closed Wednesday afternoons and at New Year. Dental and dermatology; emergencies go to the Japan Animal Medical Center (+81 3-3378-3366).
entries.note: Branch of JAMC; the clinic itself does not claim 24 h.

entries.name: Rinku Animal Emergency Medical Association night emergency (りんくう動物救急医療協会) at Osaka Metropolitan University Veterinary Medical Center
entries.duty: Night emergency only, not 24 hours: 21:00-04:30 on weekdays and public holidays, phone reception 20:00-04:00, closed Saturdays. Dogs and cats mainly. Call before coming; no phone-only consultation; credit card payment only.
entries.note: Page opened. Hours as printed; a news item says night hours were extended from 9/1 without giving new times, so confirm by phone. OMU nightmedical page says 原則年中無休 and discharge by 5:00; 2022 OMU news says 21:00-03:00 - older/conflicting, not used. Phone 072-463-5939 is the night emergency line only.

entries.name: Osaka Doubutsu Yakan Kyukyu Center (大阪どうぶつ夜間急病センター)
entries.duty: Night emergency only, not 24 hours: 21:00 to 05:00 every day of the year; reception until 04:30. Call first with symptoms and expected arrival time. Dogs and cats; ask about other animals.
entries.note: Own site opened.

entries.name: Osaka Night Pet Clinic (大阪夜間ペットクリニック) - night department of EST General Animal Hospital
entries.address: Near Shin-Fukae Station, Higashinari-ku, Osaka (street address not published on page)
entries.duty: Night emergency only, not 24 hours: 20:00 to 03:00 (last reception 03:00), open every day. Call first if unsure. Dogs and cats.
entries.note: Own site opened; no street address on the fetched page (only 'near Shin-Fukae Station'). A search listing called the operator Murai Animal Hospital night department - unverified conflict, not used.

entries.name: Hokusetsu Night Emergency Animal Hospital (大阪・北摂夜間救急どうぶつ病院)
entries.address: Hokusetsu Vets Center Bldg, 2-3-55 Funaba Higashi, Minoh, Osaka
entries.duty: Night emergency only, not 24 hours: 21:00 to 06:00 the next morning, every day of the year. Call before coming. Dogs and cats; other animals only after phone confirmation.
entries.note: Own site opened.

entries.name: Osaka Moriguchi Night Animal Clinic (大阪守口夜間どうぶつ診療所)
entries.duty: Night clinic, not 24 hours: 19:00 to 24:00. Emergency and general night consultations. Call ahead to confirm.
entries.note: Own site opened; address, phone and open days NOT shown on the fetched top page; sub-pages could not be fetched (PROVENANCE_REQUIRED). Page says it works with Kona Animal Hospital. Needs a follow-up to add address/phone.

entries.name: Sakai Animal Night Emergency Clinic (堺動物夜間救急クリニック)
entries.duty: Night emergency only, not 24 hours: reception 21:00 to 02:00, phone enquiries 20:30 to 01:30. Closed Thursdays; may close at short notice. Call before coming - patients without a call cannot be accepted.
entries.note: Own (AEON Pet) page opened. Closed Thursdays (from 2026-01-04; earlier Thursdays and Fridays); may close at short notice for staffing. Vets and staff are on site around the clock for inpatients, but emergency reception is not 24 h.

entries.name: Daktari Animal Hospital Kansai Medical Center (ダクタリ動物病院 関西医療センター)
entries.duty: Regular hours 10:00-13:00 and 16:00-19:00 (last reception 18:40). Night emergencies handled by the Sakai Animal Night Emergency Clinic, 21:00-02:00 - not 24 hours; call before coming.
entries.note: Own page opened. Page mentions 24時間365日 only in group-level text and a '24-hour nursing' department for cases needing round-the-clock inpatient care; no explicit 24 h emergency reception, so emergency_24h false. Referral from own vet required for some departments. Day-of-week table was empty.

entries.name: Higashi Animal Hospital (ひがし動物病院)
entries.duty: Open 9:00-12:00 and 16:00-19:00, closed Tuesdays (Sundays 10:00-13:00). Limited evening emergency 21:00-23:00 for dogs and cats on set days only; call ahead. Not 24 hours.
entries.note: Own site opened. Evening emergency days shown by symbols (Mon, Thu marked; Fri partial), meaning not explained.

entries.name: Osaka Metropolitan University Veterinary Medical Center (大阪公立大学 獣医臨床センター)
entries.duty: University teaching hospital. Daytime care by appointment only, weekdays 9:00-12:00 and 13:00-17:00 (closed weekends, holidays, year-end). Night emergency care is run with the Rinku Animal Emergency Medical Association - see that entry.
entries.note: Schedule page opened. Phone 072-463-5460 on an OMU news page is a director inquiry line, not a public reception line - not published, address from the Rinku association page. Official contact/access pages returned client_error.

entries.name: Kochi Prefecture Veterinary Medical Association - night duty rota clinics (高知県獣医師会 当番制夜間診療)
entries.duty: Rota of small-animal clinics giving first-line night care for dogs and cats, 20:00-23:00 (phone booking until 22:30). Call the association to learn which clinic is on duty; booking required; basic care only, no surgery or hospitalisation.
entries.note: Association page: weekly duty schedules are posted on the site (e.g. article 277); association line takes voicemail after hours. Association address not on the page.

entries.name: Kyoto Night Animal Emergency Center (京都夜間動物救急センター)
entries.duty: Night emergency care 21:30-02:00, every day of the year. Call before visiting.
entries.note: Run by Kyoto City Veterinary Medical Association, inside the Kyoto Animal Welfare Center. Home page: 365日、21:30から2:00まで診察. No 24 h claim.

entries.name: Kagoshima University Veterinary Teaching Hospital - night clinic (鹿児島大学共同獣医学部附属動物病院 夜間診療)
entries.duty: University hospital night clinic, weekdays only (not weekends, holidays or university closures): 19:00-06:00 by same-day phone appointment; dogs and cats only; separate night entrance.
entries.note: Night phone 099-285-8671 (reception 19:00-24:00 and 01:00-04:00; midnight-06:00 goes to the Anicli24 service). Only the fax line is described as 24h; no 24 h clinic claim.

entries.name: Hokkaido University Veterinary Medical Center - night/holiday service (北海道大学動物医療センター 夜間休日診療)
entries.duty: University hospital: weekday evenings 17:00-24:00 on a dedicated line; nights, weekends and holidays are handled by the Anicom24 phone service. Dogs and cats only; call before coming; night fee applies; no CT/MRI.
entries.note: Page does not claim 24 h service; the rest of the day is transferred to Anicom24. Weekend/holiday coverage by the same line per page.

entries.name: AEON Petemo Animal Medical Center Makuhari Shin-toshin (ペテモどうぶつ医療センター 幕張新都心)
entries.address: 1-8 Toyosuna, Mihama-ku, Chiba 261-0024 (AEON Mall Makuhari Shin-toshin 1F)
entries.duty: Night emergency reception 20:00-08:00 every day (call first; insurance claims at night via Anicom only). Regular hours by appointment 9:00-13:00 and 17:00-19:00.
entries.note: Page: emergency table lists 20:00-08:00; '24時間365日の緊急獣医療対応' is group-wide wording and 24時間体制 refers to inpatient nursing, so not treated as an explicit 24 h clinic claim.

entries.name: AEON Petemo Animal Medical Center Sapporo Tsukisamu (ペテモどうぶつ医療センター 札幌月寒)
entries.duty: Emergency reception 21:00-24:00 and 05:00-09:00 (night emergency line 011-598-9936); regular hours 10:00-13:00 and 17:00-20:00. Call before coming.
entries.note: Page: 24時間診療 only for patients seen at the AEON Pet group within 3 years or under a partner clinic's continuing care; site tagline says 24時間365日 generically. Not flagged 24 h. Night emergency number taken from page bottom link.

entries.name: AEON Petemo Animal Medical Center Sagamihara (ペテモどうぶつ医療センター 相模原)
entries.duty: Night emergency reception 21:00-08:00 (emergency line 042-757-3166); regular hours 9:00-13:00 and 16:00-19:00 by appointment. Call before coming.
entries.note: Meta description 24時間365日 is a group-wide tagline; own emergency hours listed 21:00-08:00, so not flagged 24 h.

entries.name: AEON Petemo Animal Medical Center Nagoya (ペテモどうぶつ医療センター 名古屋)
entries.duty: Regular hours 9:30-12:00, 13:00-15:00 (appointment) and 16:00-20:00; 24-hour inpatient nursing. Night emergency details are on a separate page - call first.
entries.note: Page does not state emergency reception hours; 24時間 refers to inpatient nursing and the group tagline.

entries.name: Veterinary Specialists & Emergency Center (どうぶつの総合病院 専門医療＆救急センター)
entries.duty: Emergency reception 09:00-01:00 every day of the year, with 24-hour ICU care for inpatients. Call before coming.
entries.note: Emergency page: 受付時間 9:00～25:00, open every day; 救急センターは、救急診療及び24時間ICU管理を行っています (ICU, not reception). JAHA directory lists 9:00-17:00 and 21:00-24:00 and general phone 048-229-7390.

entries.name: Kuki Night Emergency Animal Hospital (久喜夜間救急どうぶつ病院)
entries.duty: Night emergency 19:30-02:00 every day (phone reception 19:00-01:30). Call before coming.
entries.note: Own site gives hours and phone but no street address; address from the JAHA hospital directory (animal-hospital.jaha.or.jp). No 24 h claim.

entries.name: Kaihin Animal Medical Center (海浜動物医療センター)
entries.duty: Day hospital 9:00-12:00 and 15:00-18:00, closed Thursdays (continuing patients only). Urgent cases seen on request during hours; night emergencies are referred to AEON Petemo Makuhari Shin-toshin.
entries.note: Page names the Makuhari centre as 年中無休 24時間対応 night partner; the clinic itself does not claim 24 h.

entries.name: Fukuoka Animal Medical Center, Takeshita Hospital (福岡動物医療センター 竹下病院)
entries.duty: Day clinic 9:00-12:00 and 13:30-18:00; closed Wednesday, Sunday and public holidays. No emergency service stated; new patients currently not accepted.
entries.note: Group also runs Kasuga Hospital 092-501-3929. Page notes new-patient reception suspended as of Aug 2026; hours vary slightly between the page and the JAHA listing. No emergency claim.

entries.name: VECCS Yokohama Animal Emergency Center (横浜動物救急診療センター VECCS YOKOHAMA)
entries.duty: Emergency centre open 24 hours, every day of the year (dogs and cats mainly). Call before coming.
entries.note: Hospital page: 年中無休 24H 診療中; meta: 救急症例を24時間体制で受け入れます.

entries.name: Animal Medical Center / Japan Animal Emergency Medical Center (アニマルメディカルセンター・日本動物救急医療センター)
entries.duty: Emergency care and full nursing 24 hours, 365 days a year. Non-emergency hospital line 044-433-5155.
entries.note: amc-japan.com: 24時間365日診療 / 24時間365日救急診療＆完全看護; 99-amc.com/med-info: 24時間体制（診療・完全看護）. Same address and phone on both sites.

entries.name: DVMs Animal Medical Center Yokohama (DVMsどうぶつ医療センター横浜)
entries.duty: Night emergency centre 20:00-03:00. Call before coming.
entries.note: Page has no 24 h claim. Older 2017 JVMA article gave the former Tsuzuki-ku address/phone 045-473-1289; the current site lists Kanagawa-ku.

entries.name: Moriyama Dog & Cat Hospital Animal Medical Center (動物医療センター もりやま犬と猫の病院)
entries.duty: States it provides emergency care 24 hours, every day of the year. Call before coming; visits without a call may not be accepted.
entries.note: Night page: 年中無休で24時間救急を行っています。

entries.name: Kozawa Dog & Cat Hospital (こざわ犬猫病院)
entries.duty: Night emergency 20:00-09:00 every day, by appointment - call first.
entries.note: Page: 365日 夜８時〜翌朝午前９時; no 24時間 wording. Night number 052-733-3565; general 052-381-0235.

entries.name: Fukuoka Night Emergency Animal Hospital (福岡夜間救急動物病院)
entries.duty: Night emergency 20:00-05:00, every day of the year.
entries.note: 夜8時から翌朝5時まで 年中無休; no 24 h claim.

entries.name: Sapporo Night Animal Hospital (札幌夜間動物病院)
entries.address: 4-5-9-3 Nijuyonken 4-jo, Nishi-ku, Sapporo 063-0804 (Hokkaido Veterinary Association building 1F)
entries.duty: Night emergency weekdays 19:00-06:00; Sundays and holidays 14:00-06:00; open every day of the year.
entries.note: Run in the Hokkaido Veterinary Medical Association building (association page hokkaido-juishikai.jp confirms 011-688-9960). Site meta description shows 011-668-9960 - typo; body text and association page use 688-9960. Home page says 夜19時から翌朝6時まで年中無休; Sunday/holiday hours from the info page. No 24 h claim.

entries.name: Anes Animal Hospital - Sapporo Maruyama Night Medical Center (アネス動物病院 札幌円山動物夜間医療センター)
entries.duty: Night medical centre Mon-Fri 20:00-02:00; phone Mon-Fri 9:00-02:00, Sat-Sun 9:00-19:00; 24-hour inpatient and intensive care.
entries.note: Page: 夜間救急、24時間の入院・集中治療まで対応 - refers to inpatient care, not 24 h reception. After-hours booking 050-5536-5941 (automated).

entries.name: Kobe Night Animal Emergency Center (神戸夜間動物救急センター)
entries.duty: Night emergency 21:00-09:00, every day of the year. Call before coming; no phone-only consultations.
entries.note: 21:00〜翌9:00・年中無休; no 24 h claim.

entries.name: Chiba Animal Medical Center (千葉動物医療センター)
entries.duty: States it treats animals 24 hours a day, including holidays, with night emergency care. Call before coming.
entries.note: Site description: 祝日も24時間診療を行い、夜間救急時などにも対応する動物病院です. Regular hours not on the page.

entries.name: Chiba Animal General Hospital (千葉どうぶつ総合病院)
entries.duty: Emergency care on a 24-hour basis; emergency hours weekdays 19:00-09:00, weekends and holidays 17:00-09:00, all year. Call before coming.
entries.note: Page: 救急診療に対しては24時間体制で診療を行っております, with listed night hours; daytime covered by regular general hours.

entries.name: Sendai Veterinary Association Cooperative Night Emergency Animal Hospital (協同組合仙台獣医師会 夜間救急動物病院)
entries.duty: Night emergency 21:00-05:00, every day of the year. Call before coming.
entries.note: 診察時間：午後9時から朝5時まで(年中無休); run by the Sendai veterinary cooperative.

entries.name: JPB Animal Medical Center Chiba (JPB動物医療センター千葉)
entries.duty: Day hours 8:30-12:00 and 15:00-18:30, open all year except New Year; night emergency care handled via a separate page (from 19:00) - call first.
entries.note: Night page not opened; no 24 h claim.

entries.name: Animal Hospital Naha Night Emergency Medical Center (動物病院なは 夜間救急医療センター)
entries.duty: Night emergency 20:00-03:00 (last reception 02:30); closed Thursday and Friday; hours may change with vet availability - call first.
entries.note: Near Naha IC. No 24 h claim.

entries.name: Okinawa Emergency Animal Hospital (沖縄夜間救急動物病院, Okinawa International Animal Medical Center)
entries.duty: After-hours emergency 19:00-03:00, Monday to Friday; closed Saturday and Sunday. Call before visiting.
entries.note: English page of the clinic. Animal Hospital 22 (Okinawa City, 098-983-8822) is said by a third-party blog to advertise 24 h emergency care, but its own site was not found, so not added.

entries.name: Hamamatsu Night Emergency Animal Hospital (浜松夜間救急動物病院)
entries.duty: Night emergency 21:00-02:00; closed Mondays. Call before coming.
entries.note: Run by the Shizuoka Prefectural Veterinary Medical Association; page by the association.

entries.name: Nara Animal Medical Center (奈良動物医療センター)
entries.duty: States it treats sick animals 24 hours a day: regular hours 9:00-11:30 and 17:00-19:00, emergency reception 19:00-09:00 and 11:30-17:00 (emergencies only Tue/Thu afternoons). Call first.
entries.note: Page: 24時間体制で急病の動物に対応しています。 with listed emergency windows.

entries.name: Japan Small Animal Medical Center (日本小動物医療センター)
entries.duty: Provides night and holiday emergency care for animals that become unwell; no hours are published on the page - call before visiting.
entries.note: Page says 24時間体制の連携 (partner cooperation) but no explicit 24 h reception; no phone on the page (04-2946-7313 night line appears only on another clinic's page, not used). Not flagged 24 h.

entries.name: Hiroshima Night Emergency Animal Hospital (広島夜間救急動物病院)
entries.duty: Night emergency 21:00-01:00 (appointment line 20:30-00:30).
entries.note: No 24 h claim.

entries.name: Kitakyushu Night Emergency Animal Hospital (北九州夜間動物病院)
entries.duty: Night emergency 21:00-24:00, every day of the year except in snow or typhoon conditions. Call before coming.
entries.note: Run by the Kitakyushu Veterinary Medical Association (office 093-662-1054).

entries.name: Animal Night Emergency Center Niigata (動物夜間急患センター新潟)
entries.address: 2-13-4 Sasaguchi, Chuo-ku, Niigata 950-0911 (International Pet World College, 1F)
entries.duty: Night emergency 21:00-01:00 (phone reception 20:30-00:30), no closed days. Reservation by phone required.
entries.note: No 24 h claim. The former Niigata Animal Emergency Center in Nagaoka (niigata-aec.jimdoweb.com) closed in Dec 2017.

entries.name: Gifu Veterinary Association Night Emergency Animal Hospital (岐阜県獣医師会 夜間救急動物病院)
entries.duty: Night emergency 21:00-01:00, every day of the year. Call before visiting; no phone-only consultations.
entries.note: Run by the private-practice division of the Gifu Prefectural Veterinary Medical Association. Phone is a voice-guidance line.

entries.name: Aichi Dog & Cat Medical Center (Sugiura Dog & Cat Hospital) (あいち犬猫医療センター 杉浦犬猫病院)
entries.duty: States emergency care is available 24 hours, every day of the year; evening-night consultations 20:00-08:00. Call first.
entries.note: Page: 年中無休・24時間救急応需.

entries.name: Nagoya Night Animal Emergency Center (名古屋夜間動物救急センター)
entries.duty: Night emergency 21:00-02:00 (phone reception until 01:30), every day of the year. Call before visiting.
entries.note: Run by Nagoya City Veterinary Medical Association. Page shows no address or phone for the centre (the 052-263-1010 number on it is the Animal Information Center / telephone doctor service); access page not opened.

entries.name: VCJ Animal Medical Center Suruga Hospital (VCJ動物医療センター駿河病院)
entries.duty: Emergency (night) care is offered and the hospital describes a 24-hour full-nursing (inpatient) system, but emergency reception hours are not published. Call before coming.
entries.note: Page: 24時間体制（完全看護） under hours; service list 救急診療（夜間診療） with no hours given; image caption 夜間も診療します。 Not an explicit 24 h emergency reception claim.

entries.name: Saidai-dori Animal Hospital (埼大通りどうぶつ病院)
entries.duty: Night emergency Tuesday-Friday 21:00-24:00; closed Monday, Saturday, Sunday and holidays. Call first.
entries.note: 当院は月曜・土曜・日曜・祝日を除き、24時まで急病の動物に対応しています。

entries.name: Musashinokuni Animal Medical Center (武蔵国どうぶつ医療センター)
entries.duty: Night emergency on weekdays 20:00-22:00 (last reception 21:00); closed Saturday, Sunday and holidays; after 22:00 patients are referred to a night emergency hospital. Call first.
entries.note: Formerly Taguchi Animal Hospital.

entries.name: Ukyo Animal Hospital, main branch (右京動物病院 本院)
entries.duty: Night care on weekdays 19:00-22:00 at the main branch only; a 24-hour consultation line exists for existing patients only.
entries.note: Page: 24時間365日 なんでも相談窓口（かかりつけ専用）050-2018-2505 - existing patients only, so not flagged 24 h.

entries.name: Okayama Animal Medical Center (岡山動物医療センター)
entries.duty: Open 365 days by appointment: 9:00-12:00 and 16:00-19:00 (Tue 9:00-12:00 and 14:00-17:00). Urgent problems on holidays and New Year are handled; call first.
entries.note: Page: 365日診療; no 24 h claim.

entries.name: Nihon University Animal Medical Center ANMEC (日本大学動物病院)
entries.duty: University teaching hospital, Monday-Friday daytime, appointment only (web booking since April 2026); no emergency or night service stated.
entries.note: Hours given as 9:30-17:00 in one place and 9:00-17:00 in another on the page.

entries.name: Hifumi Pet Clinic (一二三ペットクリニック)
entries.duty: Regular hours 9:00-11:30 and 15:00-18:30, closed Mondays. Night care until midnight (not on Mondays); call first - after 19:00 calls go to voicemail and the clinic calls back. Surcharge +5,000 yen until 0:00, +8,000 yen after 0:00. Night care may be unavailable depending on workload.
entries.note: Night page opened (fukushi) and access page. One vet on duty; callback may be delayed (suggests trying another hospital after 30 min). Not 24 h. nekocafekibunya aggregator (lead only) also gave 20:00-24:00 night line.

entries.name: Kirateto Animal Hospital (きらてとあにまるほすぴたる)
entries.duty: Night and after-hours treatment offered: do not walk in at night, call first and give your expected arrival time. If there is no call back within 15 minutes, try another hospital. No phone advice. After-hours examination fee applies. Mainly dogs and cats.
entries.note: Own site (about-clinic and how-to-visit pages). Opening hours and closed days not on the opened pages (aggregator said closed Mon/Fri - unverified). Not 24 h.

entries.name: Otsuka Animal Hospital (大塚どうぶつ病院)
entries.duty: After-hours treatment is offered for dogs and cats; call 0985-48-0808 before coming. No 24-hour service.
entries.note: Own site; timetable is an image so regular hours not captured. Aggregator (lead only) says Miyazaki Prefecture has no night-only or 24 h clinic.

entries.name: Ehime Veterinary Association night emergency rota (愛媛県開業獣医師会 VET'S-えひめ 夜間応急診療)
entries.duty: Rotating night emergency clinic for dogs and cats: treatment 20:00-23:00, phone reception until 22:30. Closed Thursdays and Sundays. Check the online calendar for tonight's duty hospital and call it first. Cash mainly; extra after-hours fee (about 5,000 yen).
entries.note: Duty calendar page and rules page opened. Association lists only a fax (089-931-8988), no phone, so no phone given. Duty hospitals (Matsuyama etc.) listed on ehime-vets.jp/category/hospital/hos-coop/. One participating hospital (Ozu Mori no Doubutsu Byoin) 20:00-22:00 treatment.

entries.name: Koushindo Animal Clinic (動物病院 光心堂)
entries.duty: Mon-Wed, Fri, Sat 9:00-12:00 and 16:00-19:30; Sun and holidays morning only; closed Thursdays. Night and emergency care as far as possible - phone ahead.
entries.note: Own site; also listed as a night-cooperating member on the Ehime VMA page. Not 24 h.

entries.name: Matsuyama Hojo Animal Clinic (松山ほうじょう動物クリニック)
entries.duty: Open 365 days: 10:00-11:30 and 13:30-18:30 (closed on the afternoons of the 2nd and 3rd Thursday). Night emergencies are handled through the Ehime veterinary association's night rota.
entries.note: Own site; links to ehime-vets.jp night page.

entries.name: Murakami Dog & Cat Hospital (むらかみ犬猫病院)
entries.duty: Mon, Wed, Fri, Sat 9:00-11:30 and 15:30-19:00; Tue morning only; Sun morning by appointment; closed Thursdays. Takes part in the Ehime night rota (20:00-23:00); dogs and cats only.
entries.note: Own site. Holiday hours conflict on the page - note says holidays closed vs morning hours.

entries.name: Animal Night Emergency Center Niigata ANEC (動物夜間急患センター新潟)
entries.address: 2-13-4 Sasaguchi, Chuo-ku, Niigata 950-0911 (1F, International Pet World College)
entries.duty: Night emergency 21:00-1:00 (last check-in 0:30), every day; phone reception 20:30-0:30 and booking by phone required. Dogs and cats; credit card only. First-visit fee 10,000 yen.
entries.note: Own site overview and information pages. Night only, not 24 h. Page shows hours as 25:00 (= 1:00).

entries.name: Kanazawa Night Emergency Animal Hospital (かなざわ夜間救急動物病院)
entries.duty: Night emergency 21:00-2:00, irregular closing days - check the calendar and call first.
entries.note: Own site. Aggregator (lead only) adds dogs and cats only, cashless only - not on the opened page. Same building as Izumi Animal Hospital.

entries.name: Asazawa Animal Hospital (あさざわ動物病院)
entries.duty: Mon-Sat 9:00-12:00 and 16:00-18:00. Night treatment 20:00-23:00 and closed-day treatment 8:00-23:00 as far as possible (reception ends 30 min before). First-time patients receive first-line emergency care only. No phone-only consultations.
entries.note: Own site; latest stated hour 23:00, so not 24 h. Covers all of Fukui prefecture.

entries.name: Nagahama Animal Hospital (長浜どうぶつ病院)
entries.duty: 9:00-12:00 and 16:30-19:30, closed Thursdays and Sunday/holiday afternoons. Night emergency until midnight - call first; existing patients have priority. After-hours fee 3,000-7,000 yen. If no callback, the clinic refers to Kyoto Night Animal Clinic.
entries.note: Own site; title says 夜間救急24時まで = until midnight, not 24 h. Thu/holiday after-hours care limited to existing patients until 21:00.

entries.name: Ukulele Animal Hospital Kusatsu (ウクレレ動物病院 草津)
entries.duty: Night first-aid care: call first and leave a voicemail; if the clinic can respond it calls back within 15 minutes. Separate night fees; credit card and PayPay. Dogs, cats, rabbits, hamsters. Bring photo ID.
entries.note: Own site; night hours not published. Not 24 h.

entries.name: Mirai Animal Hospital (みらい動物病院)
entries.duty: 9:00-12:00 and 16:00-19:30, closed Thursdays and Sunday/holiday afternoons. After-hours care mainly for registered patients; call first (voicemail - a callback within 5 minutes is not guaranteed). Extra after-hours fee applies.
entries.note: Own site. District 見世 = Mise (checked 2026-11-10). Not 24 h.

entries.name: Kitagawa Animal Hospital (北川動物病院)
entries.duty: Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri 9:00-12:00 and 17:00-20:00; Sat 9:00-15:00; closed Wednesdays. Not a 24-hour hospital, but emergencies can call 059-384-1299 outside hours (answerphone if unavailable); after-hours fee applies. Dogs, cats, hamsters, ferrets.
entries.note: Own site. Mie VMA has no night hospital (per aggregator, lead only). Sunday/holiday hours unclear (image table).

entries.name: Aomori Animal Medical Center (青森動物医療センター)
entries.duty: Mon-Sat 9:30-12:00 and 15:00-18:00 (Sun 10:00-12:00; holidays 10:30-12:00, 15:00-17:00); closed Thursdays. Night emergency window suspended; after-hours help only for regular and partner-hospital patients via answerphone. No walk-ins at night.
entries.note: Own site; notice still refers to COVID-era suspension. Not 24 h.

entries.name: Yasuda Animal Hospital (やすだ動物病院)
entries.duty: Mon, Tue, Thu-Sat 9:00-12:00 and 16:00-18:00; Sun morning only; closed Wednesdays and holidays. After-hours care is not routine but emergencies are handled as far as possible: leave a voicemail or use the contact form; after-hours fee applies.
entries.note: Own site. Not 24 h; messages left after hours may only be read next business day.

entries.name: Matsuzono Animal Hospital (松園動物病院 / Morioka Animal Medical Center)
entries.duty: Closed Wednesdays; Sunday and holiday afternoons closed. Urgent cases handled promptly; call ahead.
entries.note: Own site; opening hours not listed on opened page; no after-hours rules stated.

entries.name: Sakuranbo Animal Hospital (さくらんぼ動物病院)
entries.duty: Weekdays 9:00-12:00 and 16:00-19:00; Sat and Sun 9:00-12:00 and 15:00-16:00; closed Wednesdays and holidays. No after-hours service stated on its site.
entries.note: Own site; clinic page gives only the district (Onsen-machi), no street number. Yamagata has no night hospital per aggregator (lead only).

entries.name: Iwate University Veterinary Teaching Hospital (岩手大学動物病院)
entries.duty: Weekdays 9:00-17:00 by appointment; mainly referrals from other vets. No emergency or 24-hour service.
entries.note: University teaching hospital; secondary care. Small animals not stated explicitly on opened pages (small animal department exists).

entries.name: Rakuno Gakuen University Animal Medical Center (酪農学園大学附属動物医療センター)
entries.duty: University secondary-care hospital, fully by appointment through your own vet (exotic animals excepted). Closed weekends and public holidays. No emergency or night service stated.
entries.note: Opened owners, outline, closed and companion pages: no phone number or reception hours on them (contact form only), so no phone.

entries.name: Azabu University Veterinary Teaching Hospital (麻布大学附属動物病院)
entries.duty: Weekdays 9:00-17:00 (reception closes 16:00), closed weekends and holidays. Appointment only, through your own vet. No emergency service stated.
entries.note: University hospital. Address from access page. Dog/cat not named explicitly; small animal department listed.

entries.name: Tokyo University of Agriculture and Technology Koganei Animal Emergency Medical Center (東京農工大学小金井動物救急医療センター)
entries.duty: Exams 9:30-16:00, phone 9:00-16:30, closed Fridays; weekend and holiday exams carry an extra fee. Emergencies accepted during exam hours - call first. No night emergency care; after-hours calls go to a separate 24-hour phone advice line (no treatment).
entries.note: Daytime emergency centre, not 24 h. Night care was 'in preparation' as of March 2023.

entries.name: Tokyo University of Agriculture and Technology Animal Medical Center, Fuchu (東京農工大学動物医療センター)
entries.duty: Appointments by phone on weekdays 9:00-17:00. Treats small animals and pets. No emergency service stated.
entries.note: University hospital. Address is the page's mailing address (183-8509 Saiwai-cho 3-5-8); no separate street address for the hospital on the page.

entries.name: Gifu University Animal Hospital (岐阜大学動物病院)
entries.duty: Mornings Mon-Fri (check-in by 11:30), by appointment and vet referral only. No emergency or 24-hour service; urgent cases via your own referring vet.
entries.note: Phone 058-293-2962/-2963 from the referral PDF (introduction_04.pdf), address from access page. Dogs and cats per referral form.

entries.name: Oita Animal Night Clinic (大分動物夜間診療, house calls)
entries.address: House calls only, no fixed clinic (Oita City and about 50 km around)
entries.duty: Night and emergency house-call service, roughly 19:00-6:00 (may end early). Mainly rabbits, ferrets and hamsters; dogs and cats case by case. Cash only. One vet - may be unreachable during other emergencies.
entries.note: Own site; phone only behind a call button, not shown as text, so no phone. Not 24 h.

notes: WebFetch could only open URLs surfaced by search results, so many own-site pages were reachable only after a domain-restricted search. NOT FOUND/UNREACHABLE: Tokyo Metropolitan Veterinary Medical Association (東京都獣医師会) and ward veterinary associations (no official duty-rota page located; tvma/tokyo-vet domains were not fetchable), so no duty_rota entries. Poison line: no official animal poison line page found (Japan Poison Information Center pages are for humans) - none added. Tokyo Metropolitan Government animal pages (hokeniryo.metro.tokyo.lg.jp) and Setagaya city page opened: no emergency vet list or rota, only welfare-centre phones. Not opened / skipped: Toranomon Animal Hospital (site redirect loop), Daktari Tomigaya and Kugayama branches, ER Bunkyo/Nerima/Fuchu, Grace Animal Hospital, Meguro/Taito/Toshima/Shinjuku/Chiyoda general clinics (only aggregator results surfaced), Azabu University, Nihon University (Fujisawa, Kanagawa - outside Tokyo). Tokyo Animal Hospital 24 notice of temporary relocation to Musashi-Kosugi may be stale. Aggregators (wankonowa, metropolisjapan, japanlivingguide) were used only to find leads, never as the source. OSAKA: no clinic in Osaka was found that explicitly states 24 h emergency reception, so none is flagged 24 h (all are night-only; Daktari Kansai's '24-hour nursing' is for inpatients). NOT FOUND/UNREACHABLE: Osaka Prefecture Veterinary Medical Association (大阪府獣医師会) and Osaka City Veterinary Medical Association - no duty-rota page surfaced by search, so no duty_rota entries; Osaka city/Sakai/ward pages opened list only human emergency services; no animal poison line found. Unreachable (client_error): omu.ac.jp/vet/vmc/, /contact/, /access/; 101animal.com. Blocked by fetch provenance: osaka-moriguchi-yakan-ah.jp/access/. BARK night house-call vets (barkdoctors.co.jp) page gave only metadata (no address/phone) - skipped. Leads not verified from own sites: 大阪動物ERセンター (Osaka, said to run 20:00-12:00), 河原動物病院 (Daito), かやしま動物病院 (Neyagawa) - only aggregator mentions; own sites not found. No general Kita/Namba/Tennoji day clinics were researched (only aggregators surfaced). JP other prefectures: 42 entries added (9 flagged 24 h from the clinics' own pages: VECCS Yokohama, Animal Medical Center Kawasaki, Moriyama Nagoya, Sugiura Anjo, Chiba Animal Medical Center Sodegaura, Chiba Animal General Hospital Nagareyama, AEON Petemo Makuhari, VCJ Suruga Gotemba, Nara AMC), 1 duty rota (Kochi Prefecture VMA night rota), no poison line (no official animal poison information line page found; Japan Poison Information Center is for humans). Other night-emergency associations (Kyoto City, Nagoya City, Sendai, Kitakyushu, Gifu, Shizuoka, Hokkaido) operate fixed night hospitals, entered as clinics. NOT FOUND/UNREACHABLE: Okinawa Prefecture VMA night guide (okijyu.jp page titled 夜間診療案内 opened but rota content not visible, so not added); Hyogo VMA night emergency hospital page (hyogo-vet-assoc.jp) has no address/phone/hours; Hyogo Pet Medical Center night page (hyogopet.com, client error); Kanagawa Doubutsu Kyumei Kyukyu Center (v-emergency.com, robots disallowed); Nac Kyoto (nac-kyoto.com, redirect loop); Animal Hospital Kyoto night page (client error); Ryunosuke Animal Hospital Kumamoto (24 h per a regional news item, own site not found; news page redirect); Animal Hospital 22 Okinawa City (own site not found); wolveshand.jp Chatan ER (client error); Hiroshima, Kanagawa, Saitama, Aichi prefectural/city VMA sites (yvma.or.jp Yokohama, hiro-vet.or.jp, aichi-vet.or.jp) opened but list no emergency rota. Yokohama/Kawasaki/Saitama/Chiba/Aichi/Hyogo/Hiroshima/Fukuoka/Sapporo prefectural VMA duty rota pages not found. Japan Small Animal Medical Center has no phone on its own page. LEFT: Kumamoto, Kagoshima city, Nagasaki, Saga, Oita, Miyazaki, Tohoku outside Sendai, Shikoku (except Kochi), Hokuriku, Shiga, Wakayama, Mie, Tochigi/Ibaraki/Gunma, Kobe day clinics, university hospitals (Azabu, Gifu, Rakuno, Iwate, Tokyo Univ of Agriculture and Technology Koganei not opened), general day clinics in tourist areas (Kyoto, Naha, Hakone, Sapporo). JP follow-up (2026-11-10): 25 entries added (0 flagged 24 h: no page in these regions states 24 h; the aggregator nekocafekibunya.com, used only to find leads, also reports no 24 h hospital in Kumamoto, Miyazaki, Nagasaki, Saga, Oita, Iwate, Aomori, Yamagata, Fukui, Wakayama, Mie, Shiga or Tokushima), 1 duty rota (Ehime VMA night rota), no animal poison line. NOT FOUND/UNREACHABLE: Kagawa Prefecture VMA night duty rota (kagawaken-vet.jp/dutydoc2.html and the Sunday page: client_error, so no rota entry); Fukushima Night Emergency Animal Hospital Koriyama (tbb.t-com.ne.jp: robots disallowed); Mori Animal Hospital Suzuka and Wakayama Inter Animal Hospital (http/https redirect loop); Tokushima, Saga, Nagasaki, Akita, Toyama: no own-site night clinic page found; Kumamoto Prefecture/City VMA sites list no night duty (not opened by this run); Kumamoto JARVIS partner clinics (Matsumura, Etsu, Keyakidori, etc.) and Ryunosuke Animal Hospital: only aggregator pages (anicom-ah.com) opened, no own site, so not added; Esashi Animal Hospital (Oshu): emergency page not reachable; Izumi Animal Hospital Kanazawa: night care for existing patients only and no address on opened page; Narita Animal Hospital Aomori and Kitakyushu/Fukuoka duplicates not re-researched; Miyazaki University hospital (guidance PDF: 0985-58-7286, no address, no emergency) and Kagoshima University already covered; TUAT Koganei page on tuat.ac.jp client_error. Not done: Shikoku day clinics in Takamatsu/Tokushima, Hokuriku (Toyama) clinics, Akita, Mie/Wakayama beyond the entries above, Tochigi/Ibaraki/Gunma.
